title_sq: Cmim Okazion! Tek Art N'Lagje, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Perfekt !!
description_sq: Cmim Okazion! Tek Ish-Profarma, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Perfekt !! Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 68.7m2 dhe eshte i organizuar me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen ne sallon dhe kuzhine me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma e gjumit dhe tualeti. Orientohet nga Jugu dhe ka organizim perfekt, me hapesira te bollshme. Apartamenti lokalizohet ne nje zone te kualifikuar dhe te re ne aspektin e infrastruktures, si dhe nje ndertim i ri teper cilesor i perfunduar, me punime bashkekohore ku vihet re termoizolimi i fasades, vetrata te pajisura me dopio xham termik, izolim akustik, sistemet hidraulike te markes Geberit, instalime per sistem qendror ngrohje - ftohje kondicionim multisplit, tre ashensore te nje nder markave me te njohura ne treg. Ndertimi sapo ka filluar dhe pritet te perfundoje brenda afatit 2 vjecar.
title_en: Bargain price! At Art in the neighborhood, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!!
description_en: Bargain price! At the former Profarma, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!! The apartment has a total area of ​​68.7m2 and is organized with a corridor that divides the living room and kitchen with access to the balcony, bedroom and toilet. It is oriented from the South and has a perfect organization, with ample spaces. The apartment is located in a qualified and new area in terms of infrastructure, as well as a new, high-quality construction, with contemporary works where thermal insulation of the facade is noted, windows equipped with thermal double glazing, acoustic insulation, hydraulic systems of the Geberit brand, installations for a central heating - cooling multisplit system, three elevators of one of the most popular brands in the market. The construction has just started and is expected to be completed within 2 years.
